nodes.question: How can the effluent treatment methods in the textile industry help mitigate environmental damage?
nodes.answer: Effluent treatment methods in the textile industry can help mitigate environmental damage by removing harmful chemicals and pollutants from wastewater before it is discharged back into the environment, reducing the impact on ecosystems and human health.
